itemList.description: Geophysical investigation of site for sinking borewell for supplying drinking water to the habitation either through a hand pump schemes Mini water supply scheme or piped water supply scheme by vertical electrical sounding by adopting vennur or schlumbergers method including reconnaissance survey of Geological formation Geohydroligical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinity its quality quantity and acceptability of the user indicating the location of site recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation including extra depth of 1.0 Mtr in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipes depthof drilling covering full depth of aquifer proposed to the tapped, probable yield and other information required for safe drinking and harnessing including transportation of instrument and accessories to work site Engaging Technical Personnel and labour required etc Complete. [P-45/9.4/PRED:KLB:2012-13]
